items.question: What is BluEmpress?
items.answer: BluEmpress is an Android app where you chat with a fictional AI queen character. She has moods, portraits, voice, memory you control, and a Studio desk for tasks and notes.

items.question: Is it free to test?
items.answer: Yes. Testing costs nothing and no payment or reward is promised.

items.question: Who can join?
items.answer: Adults 18 and older with an Android device and a Google account.

items.question: How do I join the closed test?
items.answer: Sign up with your email at the signup form, opt in on the Google Play testing page, then install from Google Play. See the tester guide.

items.question: Why 14 days?
items.answer: Google Play asks closed-test apps to be tested by real people for 14 days in a row. Keeping the app installed and staying opted in helps that requirement.

items.question: What happens to my email?
items.answer: It is used only to add you to the closed test and send the install link. It is not sold. You can ask for deletion at any time. See PRIVACY.md.

items.question: Is there an iPhone version?
items.answer: Not an App Store app. iPhone users can open the web version in Safari and use Add to Home Screen.

items.question: Is BluEmpress a real person?
items.answer: No. She is a fictional AI character and not a therapist, doctor, lawyer, or emergency contact.

items.question: How do I report a bug?
items.answer: Open a Bug report issue in this repository. Include your phone model, Android version, and what happened.

items.question: Is the app open source?
items.answer: No. The app and brand are all rights reserved. Only the JSON files in /data are open for community suggestions under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

items.question: Can I help improve it?
items.answer: Yes. Suggest improvements to the JSON data through issues or pull requests. The owner reviews everything and cannot promise to merge every suggestion.
